findings.label: Bundled dual-brand consent survives the rebuild untouched
findings.fix: Split consent at capture (required TradieIntel digest, optional GrokoryAI); add scope column to subscriber_consents and record one row per consented sender.

findings.label: Confirmation failure and audit-write ordering can produce a subscriber with no consent record
findings.fix: Write the consent row before calling provider.subscribe(); wrap subscribe in explicit error handling that renders a retry page and does not consume the token; make the confirm handler re-runnable end to end.

findings.label: Reinvents an HMAC token helper that already exists
findings.fix: Generalise signApproveToken/verifyApproveToken from src/lib/digest.ts:47-77 and reuse; keep payload.sig wire format and exp convention.

findings.label: Attribution data silently dropped at confirmation
findings.fix: Carry referrer + utm_source/medium/campaign in the token payload and add columns for them to subscriber_consents.

findings.label: §5 misidentifies which tests invert
findings.fix: Name both inverting tests (test 1 'returns 200 on valid email with consent' and test 6 'forwards consent metadata to the provider'); note that 'returns 400 on invalid email' changes mechanism to handler-side isValidEmail().

findings.label: Rate limiting lands after the switch-over
findings.fix: Resequence so rate limiting ships before subscribe.ts is rewired.

findings.label: New secret introduced with no scope, rotation, or reuse guidance
findings.fix: State SUBSCRIBE_TOKEN_SECRET must be distinct from CRON_SECRET; name a rotation trigger and note rotation invalidates in-flight links; set Referrer-Policy: no-referrer on /confirm.

findings.label: /confirm has no indexing directive
findings.fix: Add noindex,nofollow meta on confirm.astro and disallow /confirm in robots.txt.

findings.label: Consent schema cannot express the coming list split
findings.fix: Add scope enum column (tradieintel_digest, grokoryai_commercial) now.

findings.label: No provider-layer mechanism to route two consent scopes to two different lists
findings.fix: getProvider(scope) reads scope-specific list env vars and returns null when a scope's list is unconfigured; /confirm treats null as audit-only, skip-subscribe rather than an error.
findings.note: Surfaced during fix-up, not in the original review pass — the consent-split fix (finding 1) implied per-scope routing that the provider layer did not support. Fixed in the same pass.

verify_fixes_run.result: PASS — all 10 prior findings RESOLVED after a second round of edits

fresh_findings_this_round.label: requested_at had no source in the token payload
fresh_findings_this_round.cause: Introduced by the HMAC-reuse fix: adopting the exp-in-payload convention dropped the original issued-at field, orphaning the requested_at column three sections away.
fresh_findings_this_round.fix: Added iat to ConfirmTokenPayload; §3.6 now names iat as the source and explicitly forbids deriving it as exp - 48h.

fresh_findings_this_round.label: Test count contradictory between §5 and §6
fresh_findings_this_round.fix: §5 now reads 'two invert and a third changes mechanism'; §6 references 'the three tests identified in §5'.

minor_notes_carried_forward: KitProvider duplicate-subscribe (upsert vs error) behaviour is unverified — §8 open question 4
No GrokoryAI commercial list is provisioned in NitroSend/Kit yet — §8 open question 6, non-blocking by design
